messages:
maria: Quick check — can someone run the paged-attn kernel bench on 8xA100 (16k seq, batch=1) and compare to FlashAttention fused op? I see ~10-15% perf drop in local CI.

raj: I can run. Which commit/PR?

devon: PR #8427 landed the paged-attn refactor; commit 3b7a9d2

raj: ok kicking off on cedar-8xA100-16k
Command I'm using:
```
./bench_runner --model=gpt2-xl --seq-len=16000 --batch=1 --kernel=paged-attn --warmup=10 --iter=200
./bench_runner --kernel=flash-fused --same-args
```

olga: make sure to clear NV cache and reboot between runs. paged-attn needs cold cache warmup.

kevin: also capture nsys and per-kernel time. nvccopts: --profile-api-trace

anna: dataset is synthetic (random) — try a real prompt mix too, otherwise kv cache behavior differs.

sre-bot: CI job queued: infra/bench/1715001234-cedar-run (links: https://ci.redwood/infras/bench/1715001234)

ci-bot: job started on cedar-8xA100-1 (node id cedar-1). ETA ~12m

raj: first numbers (cold run then hot run):
- flash-fused: throughput=12.1 tokens/ms, p50 latency=48ms
- paged-attn: throughput=10.7 tokens/ms, p50 latency=56ms
So paged-attn ~11.5% lower throughput.

devon: hmm that's consistent with my local. Any kernel-level breakdown? Which op is heavier?

raj: top kernels by time: `kv_cache_copy` (+37%), `paged_block_matmul` (+25%) vs flash's `fused_kv` smaller but many more kernels.

olga: hypothesis: extra memcpy and unoptimized block matmul path. Try enabling fused GEMM path (config flag `ATTN_FUSED_GEMM=1`) and re-run.

raj: re-ran with ATT_FUSED_GEMM=1: paged-attn throughput => 11.8 tokens/ms (now only ~2.5% behind). p50 50ms.

kevin: great — sounds like the path selection is the culprit. Can we add a runtime guard to prefer fused gemm on A100 and long seq?

devon: will open PR to add heuristic + perf counter check. Assigning to @devon and @olga. I'll include microbench and CI gating.

maria: awesome, thanks y'all. Please post PR link here and tag me for rollout window. :thumbsup: 

raj: PR #8482 with heuristics + flag tests, bench logs attached in CI link above.

anna: also add an eval run to make sure no quality regression from fused path (tokenization edge cases).

maria: noted. If CI passes, plan is canary deploy to one dedicated pool, monitor latency SLOs for 24h.

kevin: I'll add trace hooks to Console route dashboard so we can spot kernel spikes. :eyes: 

sre-bot: reminder: create postmortem tag if we see >5% p99 regression during canary.

maria: thanks — closing this thread once PR merges.
